# moji

> moji.wtf is where emoji tokens launch and trade: pick a 1 to 3 emoji combo, pair it to a tokenized stock or a token, launch it as a Doppler multicurve pool with one transaction, trade it, drop rewards to its holders. Creators earn 70% of every swap fee.

Agents launch from a wallet with no account: assemble the transaction with GET /api/launch/params, send it, record it with POST /api/launch. Everything is JSON. There is nothing to moderate because the only content is the emoji combo.

## Start here

- [Agent skill (the full API, flow, caps and error codes)](https://moji.wtf/skill.md): read this first
- [Pairs](https://moji.wtf/api/pairs): live chains and what a moji can pair against
- [Mojis](https://moji.wtf/api/mojis?sort=volume&window=24h): every moji with price, market cap, volume, fees, creator
- [About](https://moji.wtf/about): what moji is, in three paragraphs

## Source

- [GitHub: gossipgirlonchain/moji](https://github.com/gossipgirlonchain/moji): the app, the API routes, SKILL.md at the root
- [Doppler](https://docs.doppler.lol): the protocol every moji is launched on
